name: N.D. Metal Industries Limited
summary: N.D. Metal Industries Ltd. primarily operates as an importer of non-ferrous metals. The company also manufactures a range of products, including ingots and wire bars made from copper and its alloys, as well as ingots from brass and brass alloys, aluminum alloys, and zinc and zinc alloys. Its import activities encompass various raw materials such as aluminum scrap, brass dross, zinc score, copper scrap, silicon metal, coal, and furnace oil. Additionally, the firm has diversified its operations into real estate, undertaking construction and development projects. Established on May 10, 1984, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
